label: Reasoning effort
purpose: Show how hard the model was told to think, and how much of that budget the run actually spent.
when_to_use: On surfaces that expose the effort/budget dial and want to report it back honestly.
when_not_to_use: When effort is not user-controllable or not worth surfacing.
composition: An effort level as a text label + a filled-segment shape (1–3 bars)
A secondary Badge naming the level
A DLS Progress bar for budget spent vs allotted
responsive: Caps at a readable max width; the header row wraps under it.
accessibility: effort is carried by the label + the number of filled segments, never by colour alone (no-color-alone)
Progress carries an aria-label with the percentage used
anti_patterns: using colour (e.g. red = high) as the only signal of effort
showing spend without the budget it is measured against
assumptions: Level, spent and budget are DEMO values — wire them to the real run.
Three effort levels (low/medium/high); adjust to the surface's actual dial.

references.note: assistant-ui's Elements catalogue (https://www.assistant-ui.com/elements, checked 2026-08) is the CONCEPTUAL reference; no code is copied. Composed from real DLS primitives (Progress + Badge) plus a token-only segment meter.
